scope: All three originals scanned with atomscan and cleave facts; static Rizin reverse engineering. No fetched dependencies. Samples were not executed. Supplied tria.ge reports were inaccessible; verdicts do not rely on their scores.

evidence: Rizin disassembly: both specimens have byte-identical .text at file offsets 0x1000..0x3000. CRT entry 0x402674 calls application entry 0x401cb0 at 0x4027a3.
Mode dispatch at 0x401efe..0x401fba selects installation paths. Current mode 3 invokes 0x401900 for Active Setup installation, then 0x401390 for self-deletion.

0x401900 creates a GUID-named Active Setup Installed Components subkey and writes StubPath at 0x401a4b; reads its own image through fopen/fread, patches mode/path fields, writes a copy through fwrite at 0x401b26 and launches it through CreateProcessA at 0x401b7e.

Alternate loader path stages resource type DLL, ID 101 via 0x402460 and writer 0x4023c0; 0x401260 replaces HKLM SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\LanmanServer\Parameters ServiceDLL with the staged DLL path.

0x401150 chooses an IE/notepad/calc process, creates it, allocates remote memory at 0x4011d1, writes the DLL path at 0x4011f5, resolves kernel32!LoadLibraryA at 0x40121a and passes it as CreateRemoteThread entry with the remote path at 0x40123d.
0x401390 obtains its own module path, converts it to a short path, obtains COMSPEC, builds /c del <self> > nul and starts the shell at 0x4014b8.

Damaged memory-dump artifacts: resolved/overwritten IAT slots and original hardcoded file offsets remain. Recovered hostile routines establish intent, without proving successful runtime installation or payload execution.

Entire .rsrc raw range 0x5000..0xf000 is zero; no DLL payload survives. Appended Microsoft PKCS#7 signed attributes verify, but the executable image digest mismatches. This is not a trusted Microsoft binary.

samples.identification: Recovered native PStore credential stealer and AutoRun worm
samples.marker: PStore AutoRun worm: remove POST/BHO overclaim; detect XOR loop
evidence: Recovered native PStore credential stealer and removable-drive AutoRun worm. UPX0 is populated, the import directory is absent and an obsolete UPX decompressor remains at entry 0x42e230. Its final jump targets recovered CRT entry 0x42b818; application startup is 0x42b19d. Damaged instructions/resolved pointers prevent a claim of successful native execution.

0x428653 transforms a NUL-terminated buffer in place with an argument XOR key; 0x428695 transforms a specified byte count. Calls at 0x42965e and 0x42a4ed decode the HTTP Content-Type and pstorec.dll with key 2; decoded facts also recover LoadLibraryA under XOR 5.

0x42a4d4 loads pstorec.dll, resolves PStoreCreateInstance and calls its pointer at 0x42a52a; COM type/subtype/item enumeration feeds report helper 0x42a48e. The helper formats username/password records and appends to global buffer 0x401000.

0x42acc8 invokes credential acquisition and returns 0x401000. Worker call 0x42b07b receives it, checks for changed reports, encodes/appends content, and passes the body to HTTP sender 0x42964e at 0x42b13a.

0x42964e constructs a form-urlencoded POST containing its body argument, resolves the URL host, creates a socket, connects to port 80 and passes the constructed request to the send thunk at 0x4297ba. Endpoint strings include bublikiadministrator.com and bublikimanager.com; detection does not require either domain.

Startup supplies thread address 0x42a20c to CreateThread at 0x42b33a. The thread loops drive letters C..X, requires GetDriveType == 2, copies the current image to a root executable, sets attributes 6 (hidden/system), and writes autorun.inf using a decoded [autorun] header and executable ShellExecute directive.
System-process names, hook API references and collector WannaCry/Remcos labels do not establish logging, ransomware or those family identities. No recovered victim-file encryption was found.

changes.reason: URL + POST template + BHO deletion establishes neither a collected data source nor C2 control. No source-to-send relation is required. Remove unsupported hostile inference; preserve the three neutral observations and the separate source-specific PStore exfiltration rule. Exact YAML consumer search found no references.

Notable, direction-neutral XOR byte transform. Counted and string-length variants share the same in-place indexed loop. No family strings, fixed addresses, key values or collector filenames; no encryption/decryption intent claimed. Existing text-scoped XOR patterns do not cover these signed-byte-load routines in populated UPX0.

verification.focused: 12 cases, 47 trait assertions passed; both loop variants, populated UPX0 and changed indirect-call address match; ADD/no-write/no-back-edge controls do not. POST/URL/BHO-only control retains all three neutral evidence legs and has no hostile findings. Three originals retain their behavior-specific hostile coverage.
verification.atomscan: Final runs use --format json --follow=none. Exit 1 denotes flagged specimens; complete reports were produced without analysis errors.
verification.final_validation: make validate is required as the final action after this review and marker writes.
